unitTestExclude.scripts/build-artifact-manifest.test.ts: Generated public GeoJSON hash lock. Artifact verification, not a behavior unit test.

lifecycleExclusions.tests/**: Playwright release tests, not production source

nativeCoverageLimitation: Node 23 NODE_V8_COVERAGE and --experimental-test-coverage record tsx compiled scripts, omit unexecuted production files, and do not emit stable source-mapped TypeScript line, branch, and function totals. c8 --all --exclude-after-remap remaps to .ts/.tsx and includes missing files as zero.
browserCoverageLimitation: Playwright release tests record Chromium JS coverage for webpack-internal application modules. tools/browser-source-coverage.mjs remaps those records through emitted source maps onto original .ts/.tsx paths, then Istanbul-merges them into coverage/coverage-final.json. Hashed /_next/static/chunks URLs are not the coverage identity.
unexecutedBranchInventory: c8 placeholder branch maps on unexecuted files are discarded. Branch denominators for those files are the McCabe decision-point lower bound: sum(complexity - 1) over inventoried production functions.
